question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.
answer_text:

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH ch.camera_location AS area, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
RETURN area AS location, CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN weighted_sum / total_samples ELSE 0 END AS avg_crowd_size
ORDER BY avg_crowd_size DESC, location ASC
